blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) together with Barangay Ugong, recently held “Libreng Bakuna”, a project that undertakes free vaccination for the elderly and the indigent. Hundreds of residents from Ugong, Pasig, trooped to the Barangay Hall to receive free vaccinations conducted by volunteer doctors and public health practitioners.
“Libreng Bakuna” is conducted regularly by RLC in different barangays in Metro Manila. The program is under The Gift of Change project.

Photo shows (R) Mr. Faraday Go, Business Unit General Manger, Office Buildings Division, Robinsons Land Corporation with (middle) Ugong Norte Barangay Norte Engr. Engracio E. Santiago and (L) Kagawad Michael C. Bernardo.
